title: 英文、日本语与收件人
text:
Mira Chen checked the radio. Ken Ito stood next to her, listening.
"Ken, stay by the door," Mira said.
Ken nodded without speaking. A message arrived: 【Lea: Mira, the east gate is clear.】
"I will take the west stairs," Ken replied.
Mira thought, "Lea cannot see the west side from there."
【Ken Ito：ミラ、こちらは安全です。】
【システム通知：通信が再接続されました】
"We heard you, Ken," Lea said through the radio.
